title: Hammer of the Crypt
description: A female warrior with purple hair stands in a gothic arched crypt, holding a massive glowing purple hammer crackling with energy. She is surrounded by hanging lanterns containing skeletons writing at desks, set against a swirling purple and blue aurora sky.
prompt: A fierce female warrior with short purple hair wearing orange and grey armor stands in an ancient gothic crypt under a swirling purple and cyan aurora sky. She holds a large magical hammer glowing with purple electricity. Multiple ornate hanging lanterns contain skeletons writing at desks, surrounded by stone arches, mist, glowing purple crystals and flowers. Dark fantasy atmosphere, dramatic lighting.
